integrity: All quantified monotonicity and sharpness statements are proved analytically from the Gamma-Poisson identity, an exact increment formula, and explicit inequalities; no finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the integer-shape subsequence for \(c>-1/3\); it does not classify extrema of the real-shape function.
The unit-scale normalization is used throughout; other scales require rescaling the additive shift.
An equivalent older Erlang or incomplete-gamma formulation not retrieved by the searches remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp integer-shape monotonicity cutoff for centered Gamma upper tails
